title.narrative: Pillar 3: Provision of a holistic and integrated package of Education and Child Protection services to 150 children at risk in Beirut suburbs to prevent public school dropout.

description.narrative: ltpgtBorderless is proposing a comprehensive and inclusive intervention aligned with Pillar 3 of the LHF 2023 1st Standard Allocation. This project aims to deliver an integrated package of Education and Child Protection services to 150 children who are currently struggling academically and facing a high risk of dropping out of public schools due to the ongoing challenging situation in Lebanon. The education sector has been significantly impacted by the political and socio-economic factors facing the countries, with families finding it increasingly difficult to keep their children enrolled in public schools, resulting in limited access to education, a higher likelihood of dropout, and higher risk of becoming victims of child labor. ltbrgtThe proposed intervention aims to address the aforementioned risks and needs through a comprehensive approach, catering to the most vulnerable children, their caregivers, and community members. Customized services, implemented in the Mixed Irshad Public School Burj Abu Haidar, will be provided to ensure children have the necessary support and environment to succeed and remain enrolled in schools:ltbrgt(1) Education Support: Many at-risk students face challenges in core subjects such as math and language skills. 150 children will receive retention support, including tutoring and remedial classes, to improve their performance and increase their chances of staying in school. ltbrgt(2) Child Protection Support: At-risk students often experience emotional and psychosocial difficulties, including stress, anxiety, and low self-esteem. 150 children will receive psychosocial sessions with focus on resilience, self-confidence, and conflict resolution to enhance their well-being and overall educational experience.ltbrgt(3) Caregivers Support: Engaging parents and caregivers in their children's education is crucial for preventing school dropout. 90 caregivers will undergo support sessions to foster a supportive environment and encourage parental involvement in their children's academic journey.ltbrgt(4) Basic Needs Support: Financial constraints, lack of access to educational resources, and family obligations contribute to the risk of school dropout. These students need assistance in overcoming socioeconomic barriers, and as such 300 children will be provided with school supplies kits, and winterization kits to address their basic needs.lt/pgtltpgt(5) Local Public School Support: In response to the electricity shortages, a stalled solar system will be completed to ensure that the Irshad public school has the required capacity of electricity to light the classrooms.ltbrgtBy addressing the identified needs through tailored interventions, the project aims to improve academic outcomes, enhance socioemotional well-being, and strengthen the support system for at-risk students in public schools. The project's ultimate goal is to reduce school dropout rates and empower these students to achieve their full potential in education and beyond. The grant sought will play a crucial role in supporting local resources to better serve vulnerable communities and create a brighter future for the next generation. All activities will be implemented by trained local staff and undergo regular monitoring, evaluation, and necessary adjustments. Measures for Preventing Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) and protection will be maintained and effectively integrated into the project.ltbrgtlt/pgt
